_comment: Registry of response-time probes. Each probe runs a representative DAX query against a dataset via the Execute Queries API and records the round-trip duration. Keep queries lightweight and identical run-to-run for clean trend comparison.
_dax_note: Use a small but representative query. 'EVALUATE ROW(...)' is a near-zero-cost connectivity baseline. For a meaningful report-response benchmark, EVALUATE a key measure with TOPN over a representative filter, e.g. EVALUATE TOPN(100, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Month], "Revenue", [Total Revenue])).
